title: Sohbeti Sürdürmek
goalTr: Sadece cevap verme — KARŞIYI KONUŞTUR. Tepki + takip sorusu = sohbetin motoru.

chunks.ex: I lived in Japan. — What was that like?

chunks.en: What do you like about it?
What's been your favorite place so far?
chunks.tr: Şu ana kadar en sevdiğin yer neresi?

chunks.en: Have you been anywhere else in Indonesia?

chunks.use: Hikâyeyi devam ettirir — anlatan kişi buna bayılır.

chunks.ex: I lost my luggage. — That's rough.

chunks.en: I've heard good things about it.

quick.q: What's been your favorite place so far?
quick.sample: Probably Ubud — the rice terraces are unreal.
Back home, unfortunately! But maybe Thailand next year.
Yeah, definitely. It's quiet and the staff are great.
Honestly? The photos. And everyone said it's amazing.

quick.q: Have you been anywhere else in Asia?
quick.sample: Not yet — this is my first time in Asia.
I went to a waterfall. It was totally worth it.
Yeah, loved it. The waves were huge though.
Just a friend from back home.

quick.q: How come you're up so early?
quick.sample: Jet lag, honestly. My body has no idea what time it is.

social.stmt: I got food poisoning on my second day.
samples: Oh no, that's rough! Are you okay now?
That's terrible. What did you eat?

social.stmt: We saw dolphins this morning at sunrise.
samples: No way! Where was that?
That's amazing. Was it a tour or just luck?
Seriously? That's so annoying. What did you do?
Twice? That's rough. Did you get a refund?

social.stmt: I've been traveling around Asia for three months.
samples: That's amazing. Which country has been your favorite so far?
Three months! What's next after this?
How do you afford it, if you don't mind me asking?

social.stmt: I spent a week in the Gili Islands.
samples: What was that like?
Would you recommend it?
Which island did you stay on?

social.stmt: I'm thinking of moving here, honestly.
samples: Wait, seriously? What would you do for work?
How come? What do you love about it?

social.stmt: Bali is way cheaper than my country.
samples: Same here! Everything feels cheap to me too. What's been your best find so far?
That's cool! I only know 'terima kasih'. Is it hard to learn?
Right? I saw one yesterday at the beach. Have you been to Uluwatu for sunset?

social.stmt: Şu ana kadarki Bali maceranı 30 saniyede anlat — ne yaptın, ne gördün, en iyi anı neydi?
samples: So far I've...
The best part was...
At first I..., then...
Honestly, my favorite thing was...

grammar.title: Takip soruları: How long / What...like / Who...with

intro.ex: Would you recommend it? / Was it worth it?

listening.audio: Which country has been your favorite so far?
options: Şu ana kadar en sevdiği ülkeyi

listening.audio: Honestly, it was totally worth it.

scenario.title: Plajda Hikâye Dinleme
scenario.situationTr: Plaj yürüyüşünde bir gezginle sohbet koyulaştı. O anlatmayı seviyor — senin işin doğru tepkiler ve takip sorularıyla onu KONUŞTURMAK.
scenario.goalTr: Her cevabında: kısa tepki (No way! / That's amazing) + takip sorusu. 'Nice.' deyip susmak YASAK.

personas.name: Tom
personas.story: hiked Mount Batur for the sunrise last week

personas.name: Mia
personas.story: did a three-day silent retreat in Ubud

personas.name: Alex
personas.story: crashed a scooter in Canggu on day two

beats.ai: The water's so warm today, right? By the way, I'm {name}.
beats.tr: Su bugün çok sıcak, değil mi? Bu arada ben {name}.
beats.sample: Right? I'm Hakan. Nice to meet you!

beats.ai: So how long have you been in Bali? I've been here {days} now.
beats.tr: Ee, ne zamandır Bali'desin? Ben {days} oldu.
beats.sample: Just a few days. {days}? That's awesome!

beats.ai: Yeah, actually — I {story}. Craziest thing I've done here.
beats.tr: Evet, hatta — {story}. Burada yaptığım en çılgın şey.
beats.sample: No way! What was that like?
That's amazing. Was it worth it?

beats.ai: Totally worth it. You should do it before you leave.
beats.tr: Kesinlikle değdi. Sen de gitmeden yapmalısın.
beats.sample: I've heard good things about it. Who did you go with?

beats.ai: Just some people from my hostel. We're still hanging out, actually.
beats.tr: Hosteldeki birkaç kişiyle. Hâlâ takılıyoruz aslında.
beats.sample: That's cool! Have you been anywhere else in Indonesia?

beats.ai: Not yet — but I'm heading to {next} next. Pretty excited.
beats.tr: Henüz değil — ama sırada {next} var. Baya heyecanlıyım.
beats.sample: Oh nice! How long will you be there?

beats.ai: About a week, I think. Anyway — what about you? What's been the highlight of your trip so far?
beats.tr: Sanırım bir hafta. Neyse — ya sen? Senin gezinin en iyi anı neydi?
beats.sample: Honestly, probably the sunset yesterday. It was unreal.

beats.ai: Nice! Okay, I'm gonna jump in the water. Catch you around!
beats.tr: Güzel! Tamam, ben suya giriyorum. Görüşürüz!
